note: North Fork Campground, about 14 mi W of Cody on US-14/16/20 above the North Fork of the Shoshone River where it enters Buffalo Bill Reservoir: a main loop on open lawn with scattered trees, an upper gravel loop on bare ground, and a lower loop in cottonwoods. Playground. The park's Lake Shore Campground is about 8 km E, nearer Cody. --Claude
